C01.name: 溪哥
C01.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, a large oblique mouth, small scales, a complete lateral line, the male with nuptial tubercles on the snout

C12.name: 缨口鳅
C12.form: a slender flattened body, a depressed head, a blunt rounded snout, an inferior mouth with fleshy fringed lips, barbels at the corners of the mouth, small scales, a complete lateral line
C12.fins: the pectoral and pelvic fins broad and spread out to grip the substrate, a low dorsal fin

C15.name: 褐鳟
C15.form: an elongated spindle-shaped body, a medium-sized head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, small cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
C15.fins: a single dorsal fin with a small adipose fin behind it, a slightly forked tail fin
C15.colour: 身体为褐色，并有黑色及红色的斑点

C16.name: 溪石斑
C16.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, an inferior mouth with a horny lower lip, barbels at the corners of the mouth, ctenoid scales, a complete lateral line

C23.name: 福建小鳔鮈
C23.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, an inferior mouth, a pair of barbels at the corners of the mouth, small scales, a complete lateral line

D08.name: 小龙虾
D08.form: a cylindrical body divided into a cephalothorax covered by a hard carapace and a segmented abdomen, a pair of large chelae on the first pair of legs, a fan-shaped tail
D08.colour: 成熟个体呈深红褐色至青褐色

S38.name: 巨口鳗
S38.form: an elongated slender eel-like body, a very large expandable mouth, a long whip-like tapering tail, small eyes
S38.fins: a long dorsal fin and a long anal fin that merge into the tail fin
